name: Example deck
description: Shows the format. Delete this file once you have real decks.

cards.front: What does the Leitner system do?
cards.back: Moves a card up a box when you get it right and back to box 1 when you miss it; higher boxes come back less often.

cards.front: Keyboard: flip / got it / missed it
cards.back:
Space flips
Right arrow (or K) = got it
Left arrow (or J) = missed it

cards.front: A back can be a list
